sprint_report.goals: This sprint focused on enhancing the SALT request management system with critical validation and usability improvements while advancing deployment and integration efforts across multiple applications including ITAM, Access Requests, and purchasing modules. The team prioritized form refinements, approval workflow enhancements, and foundational work to support production readiness across the Data Services platform ecosystem.
sprint_report.summary: The sprint delivered substantial improvements to the SALT request workflow by implementing mandatory fields such as justification and need-by date, enforcing supervisor selection on approval matrices, and validating that only sub-organization and team combinations with defined approval matrices are available to requesters. Beyond SALT, the team deployed the AMIT application to test environments, resolved critical issues with hand receipt uploads and search functionality in ITAM, enhanced notification systems with formatted approval emails to both requesters and submitters, and improved user interface consistency across Access Requests and purchasing modules. Additionally, the team completed baseline organizational changes, established production connection references for notifications, and addressed usability concerns in the Compliance Review module regarding screen layout and administrative controls. This work collectively strengthens data integrity, improves user experience, and positions multiple applications for production deployment.
